user_instruction: J'aimerais intégrer Softbank à notre modèle. Je sais que ce ne sera pas facile mais tu penses qu'il y a moyen de récupérer le maximum d'informations ?
interim_disclosure_basis: TSE Article 5-2; some IAS 34 disclosures omitted under Article 5-5
legacy_evidence_profile: Non-EDGAR remains tier F and excluded from original numeric calculations

proposed_profiles.EDINET_original_annual: Confirm filing identifier, legal entity, amendments, date and auditor scope before numeric admission
proposed_profiles.issuer_EDINET_mirror: Keep declared filing and mirrored provenance separate from direct regulator bytes
proposed_profiles.TSE_interim_reviewed_appendix: Admit only the statements and notes within verified review scope in the extended-source view
proposed_profiles.issuer_translation: Match period, amounts and scope to original filing; track translation differences
proposed_profiles.presentation_and_press_release: Discovery and issuer-reported chronology; not equivalent to audited statements or complete contracts

entity_rules: SoftBank Group Corp is distinct from SoftBank Corp telecom
Establish dated control separately for SVF1, SVF2, Arm, Ampere and operating/project entities
SVF II TSUBAKI (DE) LLC is a borrower subsidiary; parent guarantee remains a separate relation
Mandated lead arranger is not automatically a funded lender
Consolidated fund holdings do not add again to the same consolidated group exposure
Stargate announced budget is not a financed SoftBank project commitment
authorization: Ok fais l’intégration complète au mieux
architecture: Eight-table additive integration with source qualification sidecar; original EDGAR rows preserved and queryable; JP facts use extended_official_JP_sources measure variant.

source_admission_diff.legacy: EDGAR only; other sources tier F for discovery
source_admission_diff.extended: Whitelisted dated EDINET originals, scope-qualified TSE statements, audited issuer statements, and unaudited official dated transaction announcements; foreign numerical measures carry a separate variant

deadline_rule.normal_period: Three months after fiscal-year end, FIEA article 24(1); approval-based exceptions not presumed
deadline_rule.late_filing_signal: not inferred from US forms or incomplete Japan amendment search
